visual_text: Switching off ICD shocks: a conversation to have early
No operation: the device is reprogrammed from outside the body
Painless, and it can be reversed
A do-not-resuscitate decision does not switch shocks off
Wan & Chakrabarti, CMAJ 2021; BHRS guideline, Age Ageing 2024
alt_text: Drawn clinic room: an older woman in a cardigan sits calmly beside her adult son while a cardiac physiologist, seated facing her, holds a small round programming wand near her chest, over her clothes. Numbered pins 1 to 4 mark the wand, her face, a heart outline and a paper on the desk. The four numbered points below say what switching off shocks involves.
